 Ely dentist Wihlm receives final Rukavina Loan repayment award
 News 
 Today, 06:00 AM 
 Dr. Spencer Wihlm of Ely Family Dental recently received the final installment of his student loan repayment award through the Martha Mordini Rukavina Loan Forgiveness Program, an initiative designed to attract and retain dentists in northeastern Minnesota.
 Dr. Michael Zakula, president of the Minnesota Dental Foundation, presented the award to Wihlm, a 2023 graduate of the University of Iowa College of Dentistry.
 Established in 2009 with funding from Iron Range Resources & Rehabilitation (IRRR), the program has helped recruit 10 dental school graduates to practice in Iron Range communities, where access to dental care remains an ongoing concern.
 The program was championed by the late Tom Rukavina, a former St. Louis County commissioner and Minnesota state representative, and named in honor of his mother, Martha Mordini Rukavina.
 Administered by the Minnesota Dental Foundation, the program provides financial assistance to dentists who commit to practicing full-time for at least five years in the Taconite Assistance Area of northeastern Minnesota. Eligible dentists may receive up to $120,000 over four years to help repay qualifying dental education loans.
 With dental school graduates facing substantial student loan debt — averaging approximately $279,800 — the program helps reduce a significant financial barrier to establishing a practice in a rural community. It also supports long-term efforts to improve access to dental care for Iron Range residents.
 Originally from Mason City, Iowa, Wihlm attended the University of St. Thomas in St. Paul before earning his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree, with a distinction in public health, from the University of Iowa College of Dentistry in 2023.
 Wihlm and his wife, Tove, were drawn to Ely by its welcoming, close-knit community and opportunities for outdoor adventure. They are grateful to call the area home.
 The Martha Mordini Rukavina Loan Forgiveness Program continues to support the recruitment and retention of dentists who are committed to serving communities across Minnesota’s Iron Range.
 Dr. Spencer Wihlm (left) of Ely Family Dental receives his final student loan repayment award through the Martha Mordini Rukavina Loan Forgiveness Program from Dr. Michael Zakula, president of the Minnesota Dental Foundation. The program helps recruit and retain dentists in northeastern Minnesota. Photo courtesy of Minnesota Dental Foundation.
